findings.issue: Unpinned pip dependencies (pip install pymupdf duckdb boto3 jsonschema pytest sentence-transformers) in CI workflow. Vulnerable to upstream breaking changes.
findings.expected: Dependencies pinned in requirements.lock or requirements-ci.txt.

findings.issue: Nightly sync workflow runs sync_monitor.py which only computes telemetry over existing local shards. It does not execute live incremental delta extraction from AWS S3.
findings.expected: Incremental crawler queries S3 for new dates, runs PyMuPDF extraction, and emits new delta shards.
